speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: The Craftsmoogles' League have been called in to service all ten of the windmills on the Steppe, kupo. This is the No. 1 mill. / This is the No. 1 mill, kupo. She's running right now...need me to stop her? (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Right away, kupo! / That's stopped it, kupo! / Do nothing? Really, kupo? Where's the fun in that? / This is the No. 1 mill, kupo. She's stopped right now...need me to start her up? (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Right away, kupo! / That's got her moving, kupo! / Do nothing? Really, kupo? Where's the fun in that?

speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: Hello again, kupo! Got us working on windmills now. I'm in charge of No. 2 here. We've split the ten mills up among the League. / I've got the No. 2 mill in tip-top shape, kupo. Need me to stop it for you? (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Right away, kupo! / That's stopped the sails, kupo! / If you need me to stop it, just give the word, kupo! / I've got the No. 2 mill in tip-top shape, kupo. Need me to start it up for you? (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Right away, kupo! / That's started the sails spinning, kupo! / If you need me to start it up, just give the word, kupo!

speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: The Craftsmoogles' League is servicing the wind- mills on Cerobi Steppe, kupo. We're stretched thin working on all ten. This is No. 3, kupo. / The No. 3 mill is in proper working order, kupo. It's moving now, but I can stop it. Really! (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / At once, kupo! / See, it stopped, kupo! / But...but...all right, kupo. / The No. 3 mill is in proper working order, kupo. It's stopped now, but I can start it. Really! (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / At once, kupo! / See, it's moving, kupo! / But...but...all right, kupo.

speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: How have you been, kupo? We're servicing the windmills of Cerobi Steppe. This is No. 4 of ten of the finest 'mills you ever did see, kupo! / The No. 4 windmill's in perfect order. I can stop it whenever I like. Would you like to see, kupo? (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Nothing to it, kupo! / What do you think, kupo? I'd say it's stopped, wouldn't you agree? / It's really quite something to see, kupo... Kupo? / The No. 4 windmill's in perfect order. I can start it whenever I like. Would you like to see, kupo? (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Nothing to it, kupo! / What do you think, kupo? Going at a nice clip, wouldn't you say? / It's really quite something to see, kupo... Kupo?

speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: Please, please! I've work to do, kupo. We have to get all ten windmills in good order. I'm in charge of No. 5 here. / The No. 5 mill is running smooth as can be, kupo. Want to see me stop it? I'll stop it, kupo. (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / I thought you'd never ask, kupo! / There you go. All stopped, kupo! / I really wanted to show you how well it's working, kupo... / The No. 5 mill is running smooth as can be, kupo. Want to see me start it? I'll start it, kupo. (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / I thought you'd never ask, kupo! / There you go. All started, kupo! / I really wanted to show you how well it's working, kupo...

speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: We're racing to see who can finish work on their windmill first, kupo. I'm going to have No. 6 up and running before the rest! / I can stop the No. 6 mill if you want, kupo. Stop, start. Start, stop. Kupo, kupo! (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Work, work. Kupo! / Windmill's stopped, kupo! / Not interested, kupo? / I can start the No. 6 mill if you want, kupo. A windmill isn't a windmill unless it's milling! (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Work, work. Kupo! / Windmill's milling, kupo! / Not interested, kupo?

speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: The salt in the air has made a mess of these mills. We've got to service all ten on the Steppe. I'm working on No. 7, kupo. / I've replaced the parts, so the brakes on No. 7 are better than ever. Need it stopped? (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Behold the workings of a properly tuned windmill, kupo! / Stopped safe and sound, kupo. / Aww...I wanted to show you how well I'd tuned it up, kupo. / I've replaced the parts, so No. 7 should run smoother than ever. Need it started? (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Behold the workings of a properly tuned windmill, kupo! / Running safe and sound, kupo. / Aww...I wanted to show you how well I'd tuned it up, kupo.

speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: The Craftsmoogles' League's been commissioned to overhaul all ten of the Cerobi mills. I'll have No. 8 up and running again in no time, kupo! / I can start and stop the windmill with the flip of a switch. Want me to make sure No. 8's working? (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Watch closely, kupo! / Did you see it stop, kupo? / Well, maybe next time, kupo. / I can start and stop the windmill with the flip of a switch. Want me to make sure No. 8's working? (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Watch closely, kupo! / Did you see it start, kupo? / Well, maybe next time, kupo.

speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: Have to finish my work. Mustn't upset the master. No. 9 of the lot of ten is my charge, kupo. / I'm more or less finished fixing up the windmill, kupo. Just doing a few last minute checks. This is the No. 9 windmill, don't you know. It's running right now...want me to stop it, kupo? (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Here goes! / It stopped, kupo! / Phew! I'm actually a bit relieved, kupo. I'm not sure it's quite ready for that, yet. / I'm more or less finished fixing up the windmill, kupo. Just doing a few last minute checks. This is the No. 9 windmill, don't you know. It's stopped right now...want me to start it, kupo? (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / Here goes! / It started, kupo! / Phew! I'm actually a bit relieved, kupo. I'm not sure it's quite ready for that, yet.

speaker: Craftsmoogle
line_text: Nice to see you again, kupo! Got us working on the mills this time. I've been working on windmill No. 10, kupo. Trouble is, I've pretty much finished my work, but the mill still won't start. I can't figure out what's wrong... / Nice to see you again, kupo! Got us working on the mills this time. I've been working on windmill No. 10, kupo. Trouble is, I've pretty much finished my work, but the mill still won't start. Maybe there's something jamming one of the cogs... / Kupo-po!? You shouldn't sneak up on people like that! And what exactly are you doing up there in the first place, kupo? / Small wonder my work on the windmill met with so little success. You were more than dozing up there, kupo. I'd say you were hibernating! These people slew your vyraal while you were sound asleep, kupo! I saw the whole thing! / Windmill No. 10 of ten, up and running at last, thanks in no small part to the absence of that silly man, kupo. Small wonder I couldn't repair the windmill, with him sitting on the wheel the whole time. Of all the places to sit, kupo! / The Craftsmoogles' League was commissioned with servicing the windmills on Cerobi Steppe, and I'm in charge of this one, No. 10. For some reason this is the only one that isn't working. The other nine are happy as can be. Did I break something, kupo? / Just have a little fine tuning left to do and No. 10 will be good as new. Want me to stop it? (choices: Stop the windmill. / Do nothing.) / I'll have it stopped before you know it. Just a moment, kupo! / There you go! Stopped as stopped can be, kupo! / Oh, all right. Let me know if you need me to stop it for you, kupo. / Just have a little fine tuning left to do and No. 10 will be good as new. Want me to start it? (choices: Start the windmill. / Do nothing.) / I'll have it started before you know it. Just a moment, kupo! / There you go! Running right along, it is! Kupo! / Oh, all right. Let me know if you need me to start it for you, kupo.

speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: Who's been making all that noise?

trigger: requested by 大工モーグリ.風車１０挙動
speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: I'm observing! A natural philosopher must always observe. I came here to observe a rare breed of wyrm called the vyraal. The top of this windmill seemed the perfect spot for my observations, but...I suppose I must have dozed off.

trigger: requested by 大工モーグリ.風車１０挙動
speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: What's this!? You killed the vyraal!?

trigger: requested by 大工モーグリ.風車１０挙動
speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: How long I searched for it, only to fall asleep when it finally appeared! The years must be catching up with me. How could I let this happen? Maybe I'm getting too old for this...

trigger: requested by 大工モーグリ.風車１０挙動
speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: Just a moment... What's that you have there? Is that...? Could it be...? A vyraal scale! And who better in all of Ivalice to recognize it for the treasure it is than I! Please, I must have that dragon scale! (choices: Give him the scale. / Keep the scale.) / Thank you! Thank you so much! My life's work is complete! I shall treasure this for the rest of my days. I must give you something by way of thanks... Here, take this. It is a key said to open the door to a chamber holding a most terrible wyrm. / The legendry makes mention of the wyrm's ferocity, but not its whereabouts. I'm sure one who could find and slay a vyraal will have no difficulty finding and slaying this wyrm. Pray let it be a glorious battle. Farewell! / I beg of you! You wouldn't deny the last wish of an aged philosopher, would you? Pray, give me the dragon scale! (choices: Give him the scale. / Keep the scale.)
items: receives Ageworn Key; loses Dragon Scale

speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: Who's been making all that noise?

trigger: requested by 大工モーグリ.風車１０挙動
speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: I'm observing! A natural philosopher must always observe. I came here to observe a rare breed of wyrm called the vyraal. The top of this windmill seemed the perfect spot for my observations, but...I suppose I must have dozed off.

trigger: requested by 大工モーグリ.風車１０挙動
speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: What's this!? You killed the vyraal!?

trigger: requested by 大工モーグリ.風車１０挙動
speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: How long I searched for it, only to fall asleep when it finally appeared! The years must be catching up with me. How could I let this happen? Maybe I'm getting too old for this...

trigger: requested by 大工モーグリ.風車１０挙動
speaker: Wyrm Philosopher
line_text: Just a moment... What's that you have there? Is that...? Could it be...? A vyraal scale! And who better in all of Ivalice to recognize it for the treasure it is than I! Please, I must have that dragon scale! (choices: Give him the scale. / Keep the scale.) / Thank you! Thank you so much! My life's work is complete! I shall treasure this for the rest of my days. I must give you something by way of thanks... Here, take this. It is a key said to open the door to a chamber holding a most terrible wyrm. / The legendry makes mention of the wyrm's ferocity, but not its whereabouts. I'm sure one who could find and slay a vyraal will have no difficulty finding and slaying this wyrm. Pray let it be a glorious battle. Farewell! / I beg of you! You wouldn't deny the last wish of an aged philosopher, would you? Pray, give me the dragon scale! (choices: Give him the scale. / Keep the scale.)
